prompts.title: Swim
prompts.desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys to swim. Left-click (or J) squirts ink at what you point at; the ink takes a moment to refill.
prompts.touch: Touch and drag on the left of the screen to swim.

prompts.title: Dash
prompts.desktop: Press Space or Shift for a burst of speed. Creatures cannot touch you mid-dash.
prompts.touch: Tap the Dash button for a burst of speed. Creatures cannot touch you mid-dash.

prompts.title: Bomb the floor
prompts.desktop: This floor is in the way. Swim over it and drop or throw a bomb onto it: B or X throws it the way you swim, middle-click throws it at the cursor. Bombs sink, so aim down. Then swim away, the blast hurts you too.
prompts.touch: This floor is in the way. Swim over it and tap Bomb to drop one (bombs sink, so point the stick down), then swim away: the blast hurts you too.

prompts.title: The exit
prompts.desktop: Swim into the whirlpool to finish the tutorial. It takes you back to the hub, and the kelp on the dive opens for good.
prompts.touch: Swim into the whirlpool to finish the tutorial. It takes you back to the hub, and the kelp on the dive opens for good.
